environments.author: MadChase
environments.lights: Всё на Left/Right rotating lasers: ID 1–36 на каждой стороне.

environments.name: Believer
environments.author: MadChase
environments.summary: По песне Believer: много светящейся геометрии.
environments.lights: Back lasers — заливка без ID. Ring lights: 101–103 большие лазеры (101 центр, 102 лево, 103 право), 104–106 стороны пирамиды, 107–109 шары, 110 — пол (очень яркий). Left/Right lasers — ID 1, 7, 13, 19, 22, 25 от ближних к дальним. Треки шаров: Ballleft, Ballmid, Ballright.

environments.name: Cage
environments.author: MadChase
environments.summary: Куб в клетке, дорожка из летящих блоков.
environments.lights: Rotating lasers — маленькие лазеры сверху. Ring neons: куб в центре — ID 101, подсветка под дорожкой — 150–153, лазеры вокруг — 2001–2010.

environments.name: Cage Alt
environments.author: MadChase
environments.summary: Вариант Cage: куб в клетке, дорожка из летящих блоков.
environments.lights: Rotating lasers — ID 11–17 (не вращаются событиями). Back lasers — подсветка снизу, ID 150–153. Ring neons: куб — 101, лазеры вокруг — 2001–2010.

environments.name: Cave
environments.author: MadChase
environments.summary: Пещера из кубов, вода как облака внизу. Очень тяжёлая (тысячи кубов).
environments.lights: Center lights — 5 лазеров на вас, ID 101, 102, 103, 110, 115 слева направо. Left/Right lasers — из воды, ID 1, 7, 13, 19, 25. Back lasers — заливка сзади.

environments.name: Collider
environments.author: MadChase
environments.summary: Огромная труба с лазерами по кругу и летающими кубами.
environments.lights: Back lasers — все лазеры, ID 101–154. Left rotating lasers — кубы, ID 101–115. Left center lights — заполняющий свет, ID 1000–1129.

environments.name: Galaxy
environments.author: MadChase
environments.lights: Left rotating laser — сияния, ID 101–125; треки Aurora1…Aurora26.

environments.name: Moses
environments.author: MadChase
environments.summary: Расступающееся море, много отражений и лазеров.
environments.lights: Sunbeams и солнце — как в игре (солнце больше, с треком). Left/Right lasers — ID 1–9 от ближних к дальним. Water 1–4 — линии на полу, ID 1–2; Water 3 ID 101 — брызги вдали; Water 4 ID 5–6 — большие лазеры у водопадов.

environments.name: Movin
environments.author: MadChase
environments.lights: Big rings — все движущиеся огни, ID 101–364 (внизу: 346, 142–179 и 101–125, остальные — две верхние стороны).

environments.name: Abstraction
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Abstraction Environment
Showcase Maps:
- dead man walkin'
 How To Use
- Left / Right Laser ID's [1, 3, 5, 7, 9] Will effect the lasers stemming from the pillars underneath
- Left / Right Laser ID's [2, 4, 6, 8] Will effect the lasers coming from the floating cubes above
- Back Lasers Will effect the star like object in the distance and stays fundementally the same (Does not work with ID's)
- Inner Ring Lights [1 - 15] Effect the sharp lines coming out from underneath the floating cubes above
- Inner Ring Lights [17 - 20] Effect the large diagonal diamond lights
- Center Lights Will effect the 2 large straight pillars further in the background
- Ring Spin will spin the large cubes that circle around the environment (Can be seen to the right side of the screenshot)
- Ring Zoom will bounce the cubes above the player and the lights attatched with them up and down

environments.name: Cookie
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Cookie Environment
Showcase Maps:
- A Cookie From Space
 How To Use
- Left and Right Lasers both stem down from the UFO above
- Center lights effect the 3 light segment beams that stem from the UFO above
- Back Lasers will effect the bloom light in the center of the distance
- Inner Ring ID's will effect the Laser Beam coming from the UFO. Odd numbered ID's effect the smaller outer lines, Even numbered ID's will effect the larger center lines. The remaining ID's are used for the cubes scattered across the ground, 1/4th of each being hooked to each of the 4 ID's
- Rings events will spin the suspended cubes around the UFO beam

 How To Use

 How To Use

environments.name: Absence
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Absence Environment
Showcase Maps:
- in the absence of comfort
 How To Use
- Left / Right Lasers Are hovering along the sides of the track and remain functionally the same
- Water 4 are the railing lights on the right, Water 3 are the railing lights on the left
- Water 1 are the flat lighs at the bottom closer to the center, Water 2 are the flat lights at the bottom further from the center

Time Environment
Showcase Maps:
- UNUSED
 How To Use
- Water 3 effects the bulb lights to the left of the environment. ID 1 is the furthest away

environments.name: Internet
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Internet Environment
Showcase Maps:
- EGOTRIP
 How To Use
- Back Lasers are bound to background elements. LightID 1 will effect the 2 bridge beams on the floor, LightID 2 will effect a subtle background ambient light
- Big Rings are scaled up and remain functionally the same
- Left / Right lasers shoot out from the sides of the environment. They are not heavily modified by laser speed events, rather taking on a static effect with different values.
- Center lights will effect the square formation lights on the outside of the environment. LightID 1 is the right side, LightID 2 is the top side, LightID 3 is the left side, LightID 4 is the bottom side
- Ring Zoom is unused
This Environment makes use of the Cinema mod, If you want to use it then be sure to set cinemaScreen = true and download and configure the cinema.json file attatched (disabled by default)

environments.name: Trails
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Trails Environment
Showcase Maps:
- snow trails
 Setup
Currently Chromapper does not support the Gaga environment so all the chroma light ID's are bound to the default environment!
To fix this, Locate your "_environmentName" parameter in your info.dat file and set the environment to GagaEnvironment'
This should display GagaEnvironment as the environment in Chromapper and should use Default LightID's when you open the diff
 How To Use
- Back Lasers will effect the lights from the bridge supports below (not compatible with LightID's)
- Center Lights effect the aurora in the background of the environmnt (not compatible with LightID's)
- Big Rings will effect the floating light strips in the sky, each is randomized in LightID's so there is no order in the LightID's
- Left / Right lasers shoot out from the sides of the bridge and are effected by LightID's (1-7)

environments.name: Burger
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Burger Environment
Showcase Maps:
- Excited About Burger
 How To Use
- BURGER!!!!!!!!
- Left / Right Lasers, Ring & Center Lights all have been changed to bloom only lights and remain fundementally the same
- Stand lights are not visible in environment but do effect the light color and intensity that reflects off the burger
- Note that The Burger is positioned slightly above the center to keep the note spawn animations universally visible

environments.name: Screening
environments.author: Phøenix
environments.lights:
Screening Environment
Showcase Maps:
- Marchin On
 How To Use
- Left / Right lasers are suspended above the player and remain functionally the same
- Center Lights effect the bloom that sticks out from the player platform
- Ring Lights are attatched around the players periferal vision. (does not work with ring zoom) (only functional w/ all lights)
- Ring Lights IDs are attatched to the screen lights. By default there are 4 screens w/ 30 lights each. This requires 120 lights which means you will need to use the extended lightID's chromapper plugin. If you want to change these values to be below that limit, you will need 60 or lower. Set multiples of 60 for the optimal effect (4  15, 2  30, etc.)
- Back Lasers are hooked up to the tube formation lights around the environment. LightID 1 is the leftmost column, LightID 16 is the rightmost column

 How To Use
- Left / Right Lasers control the pillars along the sides of the environment, ID 1 being closest, ID 7 being furthest (Does not work with laser speed events)
- Center Lights effect the box itself that the player sits in. ID 1 effects the floor, ID 2 effects the cieling, ID 3 effects the left wall, ID 4 effects the right wall, ID 5 effects the back wall, ID 6 effects the front wall.
- Big Ring Lights effect the chess pawns in the center of the environment. ID 1 effects the front left piece, ID 2 effects the front right piece, ID 3 effects the back left piece, ID 4 effects the back right piece.
- Back Lights effect the tile pattern that lines the floor and cieling. ID 1 effects the furthest tiles, ID 11 effects the closest tiles. The floor and cieling tiles are both effected by one ID light and are seperated by row.

environments.author: Phøenix

Morality Environment

- Roots
 How To Use
